basis: Tractor Supply first explicitly established the threshold in its fiscal Q4 2023 results. Its consolidated income statement reported net sales of $3,659,841,000 for the 13 weeks ended December 30, 2023, versus $4,006,375,000 for the 14 weeks ended December 31, 2022. The reported decline was 8.6%, and sales were $146,215,250 below the $3,806,056,250 cutoff. Both figures use the company's reported consolidated perimeter, including acquired stores as consolidated in each period.

coverage.detail: July 27 Q2 release. Management lowered fiscal 2023 net sales guidance to $14.8–$14.9 billion. The range covered the full year.
July 27 public call. CFO Kurt Barton said management modeled comparable-store sales growth in both Q3 and Q4, with Q3 stronger. He gave no Q4 consolidated net sales ceiling.
September 12 Goldman Sachs conference. Management discussed market opportunity and growth. Its remarks supplied no fiscal Q4 2023 consolidated sales range.
September 13 Piper Sandler conference. The quarter-specific discussion of Q4 approaching flat concerned retail price inflation.

October 26 Q3 release. The fiscal-year net sales outlook of $14.5–$14.6 billion minus nine-month sales of $10,895,900,000 implied Q4 sales of $3,604,100,000–$3,704,100,000. Even the high end cleared the cutoff. This is a secondary arithmetic implication of annual guidance.
October 26 issuer presentation, slide 9. The slide labels the $14.5–$14.6 billion net sales range as the updated full-year 2023 outlook.

October 26 public call. Barton expected a low- to mid-single-digit Q4 comparable-store sales decline. He separately identified about $225 million of prior-year sales from the extra week. Neither figure set an upper bound on total Q4 2023 sales, which also included non-comparable stores.
November 9 Form 8-K exhibit. The issuer announced a $1.03 quarterly dividend and gave no sales update.
November 14 Stephens conference. Management discussed Q4 weather sensitivity and seasonal-category demand without quantifying a consolidated quarterly sales ceiling.
January 9 issuer notice. Tractor Supply scheduled results for February 1 before market open and provided no preliminary sales figure.
January 14 National Retail Federation keynote. CEO Hal Lawton discussed the business and its growth without giving fiscal Q4 2023 consolidated sales.

February 1 issuer release. The quarterly columns of the consolidated income statement show net sales of 3,659,841 and 4,006,375 in thousands of dollars. The release separately reports a 4.2% comparable-store decline.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer's IR results page displays February 1, 2024. The matching SEC Exhibit 99.1 carries the same dateline and announces the results that day. The January 9 issuer notice independently identifies February 1 as the scheduled public release date.
